title: What's New: Shopify Connector - Overview (2026 release wave 1)

features.name: Item variant images and attributes support
features.description: Support for images and item attributes in variants, which can be synchronized with Shopify and configured as product options.

features.name: Shopify collections import and mapping
features.description: Import custom collections from Shopify and map items during export using filter pages and item category codes to determine collection inclusion.
caveats: Manual collections only, not automatic collections

features.name: Item import from Shopify with product details
features.description: Import items from Shopify to Business Central including images, descriptions, title, price, cost, and marketing text as description.
caveats: Complex HTML layouts in marketing text may not transfer correctly

features.name: Meta field support including article links
features.description: Support for Shopify meta fields including new article type that links to blog posts, available in Business Central APIs for import and export.

features.name: Separated product and price update controls
features.description: Ability to isolate product information and price synchronization processes, allowing independent control over when each is updated to Shopify.

features.name: Unit cost in price synchronization
features.description: Unit cost is now included in regular price synchronization to Shopify, sending updated cost information even when price has not changed.
caveats: Average unit cost commonly used by merchants

features.name: Tax code field removal
features.description: Tax code field is no longer supported in the connector due to Shopify API updates requiring removal of this field.
caveats: Check if other Shopify extensions depend on this field

features.name: Presentment currency in sales documents
features.description: Support for presentment currency (local checkout currency) in sales documents imported from Shopify, allowing customers to pay in local currency while storing conversion information.
caveats: Requires manual setting change for upgraded stores to use presentment currency
Works with market catalogs for different prices by country

features.name: Fulfillment troubleshooting information
features.description: New action added to get additional information about fulfillment details received with orders for troubleshooting purposes.

features.name: Fulfillment limitations removed
features.description: Previous limitations on fulfillment have been resolved, including support for quantity increases, Buy X Get Y discounts with same items, and assembly bundles in Shopify.

features.name: Shopify API field changes for return information
features.description: Shopify updated their API to use a new field for return information, which Business Central now imports to a different field location.
caveats: Requires awareness of field location change

features.name: Shopify API version upgrade to January 2026 release
features.description: Upgrade to Shopify API version released in January with validity through December 2026, including improvements to inventory availability, bulk operations, and variant support.
caveats: Recommended to upgrade in April for smooth operations through year end

features.name: Product variant support for 2000 variants
features.description: Support for items with up to 2000 product variants in Shopify, with recommendations to test if managing items with large variant counts.
caveats: Should test if managing items with many variants
